bullets.title: A Glimpse of the Future: Electroceuticals for 70%–90% Remission of Depression, Brain Stimulation for Sports Performance, and De-risking Ibogaine for TBI/PTSD
bullets.note: I believe this podcast episode is a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next five years. Pair it with Nolan’s latest groundbreaking study, which was published this morning in _Nature Medicine_: “[Magnesium–ibogaine therapy in veterans with traumatic brain injuries](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-023-02705-w).”

bullets.title: A message for the New Year
bullets.note: from [Brandon Stanton](https://tim.blog/2018/06/18/brandon-stanton-humans-of-new-york/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), creator of [Humans of New York](https://www.humansofnewyork.com/). This relates to something he and I have texted about often: attention. How should you think about protecting your own attention in 2024? If you don’t have attention, the time you have and the money you make don’t matter much. Attention is the mother resource.

bullets.title: Conan O’Brien Can’t Stop
bullets.note: If you want to see the real Conan, the indefatigable master comic with a penchant for punching people, this is for you. It’s also a portrait of someone in transition. In this case, after Conan’s split with NBC, he was legally prohibited from entertaining on television for one year. So what do you do when your identity is taken from you? Or more broadly, how does someone at the top of their game reinvent themselves for a year? From the official description: “After a much-publicized departure from hosting NBC’s ‘Tonight Show,’ Conan O’Brien hit the road with a 32-city music-and-comedy show. _Conan O’Brien Can’t Stop_ is an intimate portrait of an artist trained in improvisation, captured at the most improvisational time of his career.” Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dRdpC1jtZE0). Hat tip to [Chris Beresford-Hill](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrisberesfordhill/) for the recommendation!

bullets.title: The Tim Ferriss Experiment
bullets.note:
TV show!** I’m thrilled to announce that I’ll be releasing all episodes of my TV show, _The Tim Ferriss Experiment,_ on YouTube—for free. It was a maze to secure the rights, but now it’s done._​  
​  
​_[**Click here for episode #1**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FBjWEwkl_s0)**!** The show is like _MythBusters_ meets Jason Bourne. In every episode, I partner with the world’s best and most unorthodox teachers (e.g., Laird Hamilton, Marcelo Garcia, Stewart Copeland), who train me for a final gauntlet. Shocking breakthroughs, injuries, epiphanies, and disasters are all part of the journey. Along the way, I show you how to replicate results in an attempt to prove that “you don’t need to be superhuman to get superhuman results… you just need a better toolkit.” Make sure to **subscribe to** [**my YouTube channel**](http://youtube.com/timferriss) to get notified of all upcoming episodes, and I’ll be releasing one per week for the next 13 weeks or so. Enjoy!
